batch.topic: A hobbyist labels boxes of finished pottery and unglazed pieces; a label describes the contents, not permission to sell them.
Neighbours arrange watering plants during an absence; the person receiving instructions checks soil before watering, rather than watering automatically every day.
A family copies photographs to a drive before clearing an old phone; preserve completion and who will check that copies open.
A volunteer changes a noticeboard poster after the updated room number is confirmed; leaving a draft on the desk does not authorize replacing the poster.
